items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: a friend of mine, Sidney Cates, he was taking it up at the time.

ctx.x: Did you ever play any other instruments when you were a kid even before you took up cornet, like guitar, fool around with them?

No, the only thing I did fool around with as a kid was piano. I fooled around with it. To be honest I never did turn out to really be a pianist. I know the Kord Foundation, I'm not much on the article. Your mother had a piano in there at home I guess. I just sort of picked it up that way a little around there because that was about the first thing. But incidentally though, I was given a banjo by a guy. The guy just gave a banjo, but I didn't even know the guy. I mean it was a big surprise. I did start on that…
Do you remember any of the parades or any other early bands or dance artisers when you were a kid?
